name: Romanian Deadlift
trainingPurpose: Posterior chain strength and hip hinge patterning
setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart, barbell against the thighs, soft bend in the knees.
execution: Push the hips back while lowering the bar along the legs, keeping the spine neutral. Reverse the motion by driving the hips forward.
cues: Push your hips back like closing a car door with them
Keep the bar close to your legs the whole way down
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstrings, not when your back rounds
commonMistakes: Turning it into a squat by bending the knees too much
regression: Romanian Deadlift with dumbbells or a light kettlebell
contraindications: Caution with acute lower back injury or disc issues; coach closely on spinal position.
tsbProgrammingNotes: Primary posterior chain hinge for most lower-body days.

name: Barbell Back Squat
setup: Bar racked across the upper back, feet shoulder-width, braced core.
execution: Sit the hips down and back while keeping the chest up, descend to at least parallel, then drive back up.
cues: Screw your feet into the floor
Keep your chest tall throughout the descent
contraindications: Modify depth or load with acute knee or hip pain.
tsbProgrammingNotes: Primary squat pattern for most strength blocks.

name: 90/90 Hip Lift
trainingPurpose: Glute activation and hip control warm-up
setup: Lie on your back with shins resting on a bench at a 90/90 position.
execution: Drive through the heels to lift the hips, squeezing the glutes at the top.
cues: Squeeze the glutes, not the lower back
commonMistakes: Overarching the lower back to gain height
tsbProgrammingNotes: Common warm-up activation drill before lower-body sessions.
